versions.changelog:
Initial release of daily-market-report.

- Generates daily US stock market analysis for user-defined holdings using Yahoo Finance data
- Displays portfolio P&L, 52-week ranges, analyst ratings, and actionable suggestions
- Includes market indices (QQQ, DIA, SPY) tracking and customizable holdings/indices
- No API key required; uses Python and yfinance
- Simple configuration and setup instructions provided for all major platforms
